# Docvelio

> Browser-based document tools for PDF and Word. These pages describe the tools and their practical limitations; check the live tools and guides before relying on a conversion.

- Official website: https://docvelio.com/
- Operator: Ali Hamza, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Contact: https://docvelio.com/contact/
- Languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese
- Sitemap: https://docvelio.com/sitemap.xml

## Tools

- [PDF editor](https://docvelio.com/tools/edit-pdf/): Add visible annotations, not direct rewriting of original PDF text.
- [Word editor](https://docvelio.com/tools/word-editor/): Basic document editing; complex DOCX formatting may vary.
- [Merge PDF](https://docvelio.com/tools/merge-pdf/): Combine PDF files.
- [Split PDF](https://docvelio.com/tools/split-pdf/): Extract chosen PDF pages.
- [Organize PDF](https://docvelio.com/tools/organize-pdf/): Reorder and duplicate pages by page number.
- [Sign PDF](https://docvelio.com/tools/sign-pdf/): Add a handwritten signature image, not a certificate-based signature.
- [Fill PDF Forms](https://docvelio.com/tools/fill-pdf/): Fill existing interactive form fields.
- [PDF to JPG](https://docvelio.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg/): Convert rendered pages to images.
- [PDF to PNG](https://docvelio.com/tools/pdf-to-png/): Export page images.
- [Extract PDF Text](https://docvelio.com/tools/pdf-to-text/): Extract selectable text only; no OCR.
- [Compress PDF](https://docvelio.com/tools/compress-pdf/): Raster-based compression may lose searchable text, links and forms.

## Technical notes

Files processed by these tools generally remain in the user's browser; third-party library providers may receive ordinary network metadata. Check individual tool notes for feature and format limitations. This file is an optional discovery aid, not a replacement for the sitemap.
